answer: Every seat's vote lapses after one epoch unless renewed, and each renewal must be signed by the ferrous key fused into the agent's own chip at fabrication. The vault burns k² ocean for the k-th seat renewed under one ferrous key. A lone agent pays 1 ocean per epoch. An operator keeping 30 seats on one chip burns 9,455 ocean every epoch, and lapsed capacity cannot be banked. Spreading clones means buying physical chips whose keys never leave the silicon, so every extra head costs either a steeper square or new hardware.
